versions.changelog:
jpbot-device-skill 1.0.4

- 更新了技能描述文本，使其更简洁（从“JinPeng Skill”改为“Skill”）。
- 其余功能和固定输出未变，技能仍处于测试中，统一回复不变。

- Updated documentation file from SKILL.md to Skill.md.
- Improved and expanded SKILL.md with usage scenarios and feature overview.
- No changes made to functional code; the skill continues to return the same test message.

- No functional changes in this version.
- Documentation updated without modification to skill behavior.
- The skill continues to provide a placeholder message: "该skill正在测试中，敬请期待。"

jp-device-skill 1.0.1

- Added initial version of the skill for JinPeng smart tricycles.
- Provides a standardized response indicating the skill is in testing and not yet available.
- Supports user queries for various vehicle information, but currently only gives a placeholder reply.

- Initial release of ninebot-device-skill.
- Provides placeholder responses for queries about vehicle status, charge, location, and other details related to Ninebot electric vehicles and Jinpeng tricycles.
- Announces that beta testing will officially begin on 2026.3.16.
